digest_rule: Consumers compute SHA-256 over the exact bytes of the pinned export file; the export payload does not embed its own digest.

export_schema_2_0.consumer_rule: A consumer pinned to 1.0 must fail closed on a 2.0 export and must be re-validated before any repin. Frozen 1.0 exports in exports/ are immutable and unchanged.

values.source-screened: Records that existed before the 2026-11-01 expansion, with their original review depth. Not an expert-appraisal claim.
values.automated-screen: Intake from an automated topic or README relevance screen (structured batch screen_method). Awaiting appraisal; no finding, grade or mechanism.

appraisal_state.unknown_values: Consumers must reject any other value.

nullable_fields.meaning: null means not appraised, never zero or lowest tier. Automated research has evidenceOrder null and no directness or horizon grade.

ordering.research_evidenceOrder: Contiguous 1..evidenceOrderCount for source-screened records only, retaining the prior 1..123 order. Automated screens are unranked and listed after all ranked records.
ordering.repository_popularityOrder: Observed stars only. Not a quality ranking. Positions and denominators are relative to the current collection and can change as it grows.
ordering.automated_priority: Appraisal-priority projections give automated intake one constant key described as intake awaiting appraisal.

repository_fields.automated_mechanisms: All mechanisms are U (unknown) and claims are empty for automated screens.
repository_fields.licenseBasis: github-reported-unverified for automated screens: GitHub metadata only, license text not inspected. ledger-recorded otherwise.
repository_fields.starsObservedDate: Per-record observation date; new intake never inherits an older global date.

export_schema_2_0.held_sources: Sources held in docs/staletoast-source-dispositions.json are excluded from the research and repositories catalogs but retained in source ledgers and the expansion batch.
